zz_ef_cm_has_bank_company = {
	OR = {
		has_company = company_type:company_BasicBank
		zz_ef_cm_has_flavoured_bank_company = yes
	}
}

### The central bank is a state building placed by E&F, not something anyone
### builds, so ownership of it is the only honest test for "has a central bank".
zz_ef_cm_has_central_bank = {
	any_scope_state = {
		has_building = building_bank
	}
}
